preview: Sarah: No worries, autocorrect gets the best of us. Enjoy the rest of your weekend, Mark.

messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill

Mark, I'm sorry. We told you October 31 and that date came and went.

Your Magic Miner 40T hasn't shipped yet, and Shop···· now ships November 30. All 300 units were built and set to leave the factory together on November 12. We emailed you about this on November 3, and again on November 8 with photos from the factory visit. Your Power Kit and Miner Duster are already set aside for you at our Chattanooga warehouse, and they'll ship in the same box as the miner.

You can follow the shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

As soon as your box is labelled, tracking will go to (email hidden)

On November 3rd as well as on Sunday November 8th your email said that model will ship November 12th... Since when did wave 1 get moved back from November 12th to November 30th? Your shipment status page shows literally nothing, just "No shipment matches that model. It may already be in stock, or not on its way yet."
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Handed to the team · Can't confirm that the units left the factory or where the freight is, and the s

You're right to question it, Mark. The two dates aren't measuring the same thing. November 12 was the date the units were supposed to leave the factory in China. November 30 is the ship date now on your order for it to leave our Chattanooga warehouse, which allows for the freight and check-in. I can't see when that date was put on the order.

I also can't confirm whether the units actually left the factory on the 12th or where the freight is now. And if the status page isn't showing it, that's on us to fix. I've asked the team for those answers. They're offline until Monday at 10am ET, and their reply will come to your email.
I don't want to bother them you retarded robot.

Fair enough, Mark. It's no bother to them. You asked a fair question, and a status page that shows nothing is something they need to know about anyway.

What I can give you for certain: your Wave 1 Magic Miner 40T hasn't shipped, the date on your order is November 30, and your Power Kit and Miner Duster are already set aside in Chattanooga to go in the same box. You don't need to do anything. Tracking will come to your email once the box is labelled.
I do not want to bother people about this you tard machine, it was my misunderstanding, and your team has already made it up to me.
Handed to the team · Customer withdrew the earlier question and asked not to be contacted about it

I sent a follow-up flag telling the team Mark doesn't want a reply to his earlier question, so they shouldn't email him about it. I didn't add a review request or an end-of-chat question, since he's angry and wants this closed.

Understood, Mark. I've let them know you don't need a reply, so nobody will chase you about this.

Your Magic Miner 40T ships November 30, with the Power Kit and Miner Duster in the same box. Tracking will come to your email once it's labelled.
I am not angry, you inconsiderate brainless program.

Sorry, Mark. That note about you wasn't meant to be in my reply, and I was wrong to call you angry. You weren't. You asked a fair question and then told me plainly not to take it further.

Nothing else is needed from you. Your 40T ships November 30, and tracking will come to your email.
Where is the review request you mentioned?

At the end of a chat we usually invite customers to leave a review on Trustpilot, and I left that out of this one. Since you asked, here it is: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Honest feedback either way is welcome, including on this chat. You're also welcome on our Discord for news on new products and help with your gear: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Top scores - thanks you the clarification you simulated imbecile.
Thanks, Mark, I appreciate that. Your 40T ships November 30, and tracking will come to your email once it's labelled. A copy of this chat will also come to you by email once we're done here.
Thanks for* the clarification (I blame autocorrect)
No worries, autocorrect gets the best of us. Enjoy the rest of your weekend, Mark.
